text: On April 29, 2024, the management team of NB Renaissance Partners entered into an agreement with Neuberger Berman Group LLC to transition from a minority to a majority owner in Renaissance, with NB becoming a minority shareholder.

source.name: NB Renaissance website, footnote 5 (firm overview)
source.quote: the management team of NB Renaissance Partners (“Renaissance”) entered into an agreement with Neuberger Berman Group LLC (“NB”) to transition from a minority to a majority owner in Renaissance
